description: Defines classes and functions for managing intrusive and thread-safe free memory block lists, including intrusive linked list implementation, batch operations, and mutex-protected stack for memory blocks.

classes.name: intrusive_memory_block_list
classes.description: Intrusive linked list managing memory blocks with push, pop, batch, and steal operations.

classes.name: concurrent_free_memory_block_list
classes.description: Thread-safe stack of memory blocks with mutex protection, supporting push, pop, batch, and steal operations.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a memory block to the list or stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top memory block from the list.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a memory block, returning nullptr if empty.

methods.name: try_pop_batch
methods.description: Removes up to n memory blocks as a batch.

methods.name: steal_top
methods.description: Transfers the top node from another list.

methods.name: steal_blocks
methods.description: Transfers all blocks from another list.

methods.name: try_pop_list
methods.description: Attempts to pop a batch of n blocks.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Thread-safe push of a memory block.

methods.name: steal_blocks
methods.description: Thread-safe transfer of blocks from another list.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Thread-safe attempt to pop a block.

methods.name: try_pop_list
methods.description: Thread-safe attempt to pop a batch of blocks.
